Rashi on Sotah 36b:10:1.english: In private - For he was secluded with a forbidden woman, and he restrained himself and conquered his [evil] inclination.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:10:2.english: Judah, who sanctified the name of Heaven in public - At the sea, as [explained] below.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:10:3.english: [His] entire [name] is called - The four-letter Name is included in the name of Judah.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:11:1.english: For a matter of sin - And this "his work" [refers to] sexual intercourse.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:13:1.english: Wastes his riches - [A] good name, which is more precious than all wealth.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:14:1.hebrew: קשתו - שכבת זרעו, על שם שיורה כחץ:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:14:1.english: His bow - His semen, [so called] because it shoots like an arrow.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:14:2.hebrew: ויפוזו - לשון ויפוצו, שהזיי"ן והצד"י מתחלפין, כמו זעקת — צעקת:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:14:2.english: And they were dispersed [vayafozu] - An expression of vayafutzu [and they were scattered], for [the letters] zayin and tzadi interchange, like za'akat [and] tza'akat.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:14:3.english: That he dug his fingers into the ground - And leaned upon them so that he would suffer pain and be preoccupied with his pain, and the force of his [evil] inclination would pass.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:15:1.hebrew: מידי אבירותיו של יעקב - משם זכה להיות רועה, ומשם זכה להיות באבן מאבני ישראל:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:15:1.english: By the hands of the might of Jacob - From there he merited to be a shepherd, and from there he merited to be [inscribed] on a stone of the stones of Israel.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:15:2.english: Shepherd of Israel, give ear - [This] is said with reference to the Divine Presence.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:15:3.hebrew: נוהג כצאן יוסף - קרי: כצאן יוסף, המנהיגים כצאנו של יוסף. אלמא מיקרו ישראל צאנו של יוסף, והוא הרועה:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:15:3.english: Who leads like the flock of Joseph - Read [it as] "like the flock of Joseph" — [meaning] those who lead [Israel] like Joseph's flock. Thus, Israel are called Joseph's flock, and he is the shepherd.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:16:1.hebrew: אלה תולדות יעקב יוסף - תולדות שיצאו מיעקב, כנגדן ראוי לצאת מיוסף:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:16:1.english: These are the generations of Jacob, Joseph - [The] generations that came forth from Jacob — corresponding to them [it was] fitting to come forth from Joseph.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:16:2.english: And even so, they descended from his brother Benjamin - Those ten [tribes] that were diminished from Joseph through his ten fingers.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:17:1.english: Who dwelled in a lodging - In a foreign land.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:18:1.hebrew: מופים - מפורש במדרש רבי תנחומא, שהיה פיו כפי יעקב אבינו בהלכות שקיבל משם ועבר:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:18:1.english: Muppim - It is explained in Midrash Rabbi Tanchuma that his [Joseph's] mouth was like the mouth of Jacob our father in the halakhot that he [Jacob] received from Shem and Ever.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:19:1.english: Astrologers - Wise men and stargazers, and [those] knowledgeable in the science of the constellations.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:19:2.hebrew: גנוני מלכות - גווני מלכות, בחכמה, גבורה ויופי:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:19:2.english: Royal characteristics - Traits [lit., colors] of royalty, in wisdom, strength, and beauty.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:1:1.hebrew: לא כדרך שחלוקין בחומש הפקודים - כלומר, לא כדרך שסדורים בחומש הפקודים — הוא ספר וידבר — שנסדרו בראשו "אלה שמות האנשים אשר יעמדו" וגו' (במדבר א׳:ה׳):
Rashi on Sotah 36b:1:1.english: Not the way that they are divided in the Book of Numbers - That is to say, not in the order that they are arranged in the Book of Numbers [Chumash HaPekudim] — which is the Book of Vayedabber — at the beginning of which they are arranged, "These are the names of the men who shall stand," etc. (Numbers 1:5).

Rashi on Sotah 36b:1:2.hebrew: בחומש שני - בתחילת ואלה שמות: ראובן, שמעון, לוי ויהודה, ויששכר וזבולון — באחד מהן; בשני — בנימין, דן ונפתלי, גד ואשר ויוסף:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:1:2.english: In the second book - At the beginning of [the portion of] Ve'eleh Shemot [Exodus 1:2–5]: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun [were inscribed] on one of them [i.e., one of the two ephod stones]; on the second [stone]: Benjamin, Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher, and Joseph.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:20:1.english: He appointed it in Joseph [Yehosef] for a testimony - The end of the verse [is], "the speech of one that I did not know I heard."

Rashi on Sotah 36b:22:1.english: Request [dissolution] of your oath - Ask of the Sages that they annul it for you.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:3:1.hebrew: א"כ מה ת"ל כתולדותם - הואיל ולא כדרך לידתן נסדרו:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:3:1.english: If so, what does Scripture mean [by] “according to their birth” - Since they were not arranged in the order of their birth.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:3:2.hebrew: תיובתא דרב כהנא - דלכולי עלמא אין זה סדר הר גריזים והר עיבל, דאילו סדר הר גריזים — שמעון ולוי ויהודה יששכר ויוסף ובנימין, ודהר עיבל — ראובן גד ואשר וזבולון דן ונפתלי:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:3:2.english: A refutation of Rav Kahana - For according to everyone, this is not the order of Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal; whereas the order of Mount Gerizim [is] Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin, and [that] of Mount Ebal [is] Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:4:1.hebrew: מרובה מחציו כו' - והיינו דקאמר "והחציו אל מול הר עיבל", החציו — ממועט שבחציו:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:4:1.english: Larger than the half of it, etc. - And this is what [Scripture] says: "And the half of it [vehachetzyo] facing Mount Ebal" — "the half of it" [means] the smaller of its [two] halves.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:4:2.hebrew: מפני שלוי למטה - זקני כהונה ולויה היו עם הארון בין שני ההרים, כדלקמן:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:4:2.english: Because Levi [was] below - The elders of the priesthood and the Levites were with the Ark between the two mountains, as [is stated] further on.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:5:1.hebrew: כל שכן דבצרי להו - חציו של הר גריזים, שהרי שבט לוי מהן היה:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:5:1.english: All the more so that they were fewer - [meaning] the half [of the tribes] of Mount Gerizim, for the tribe of Levi was [one] of them.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:5:2.hebrew: אלא הכי קאמר אע"פ ששבט לוי למטה - אפ"ה, חציו של הר גריזים מרובה מפני שיוסף עמהן, ומרובין היו:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:5:2.english: Rather, this is what it is saying: Although the tribe of Levi was below - Even so, the half [of the tribes] on Mount Gerizim was more numerous, because Joseph was with them, and they were numerous.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:5:3.hebrew: וידברו בני יוסף וגו' - סופו דקרא, "ואני עם רב אשר עד כה ברכני ה'":
Rashi on Sotah 36b:5:3.english: And the children of Joseph spoke, etc. - The end of the verse [is]: "seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the Lord has blessed me thus."

Rashi on Sotah 36b:6:1.hebrew: עולי עין - עולין על העין, ואין העין עולה עליהם:
Rashi on Sotah 36b:6:1.english: Those who rise above the eye - They rise above the [evil] eye, and the [evil] eye does not rise over them.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:7:1.english: And let them grow into a multitude - Thus Jacob blessed Manasseh and Ephraim.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:8:1.english: They were one less [than fifty] - It refers to the second stone.

Rashi on Sotah 36b:9:1.english: We require “according to their birth” - Like the names that their father called them.

Tosafot on Sotah 36b:11:1.hebrew: לעשות צרכיו - נראה משום דהוציאו בלשון ביאה — "ויבא הביתה" — קא דייק נמי דלעשות צרכיו נכנס:
Tosafot on Sotah 36b:11:1.english: To fulfill his needs - It seems [that] because [Scripture] expressed it using the term "coming" [bi'ah] — "and he came into the house" — [the Amora] also infers that he entered to fulfill his [sexual] needs.

Tosafot on Sotah 36b:13:1.hebrew: באותה שעה באתה דיוקנו של אביו - כתב רבינו משה הדרשן: "ואין איש מאנשי הבית" [שם בבית — דמשמע דוקא מאנשי הבית] לא היה שם, מכלל דאיש אחר שלא מאנשי הבית — כלומר, חלוק ומופלג מתורת אנשי הבית — היה שם, וזהו דמות דיוקנו של אביו. ותימה קצת: מנלן דנראית לו בחלון? ושמא מדכתיב "בבית", דמשמע בבית לא:
Tosafot on Sotah 36b:13:1.english: At that moment his father’s image came - Rabbeinu Moshe HaDarshan wrote: "And there was no man of the men of the house" [there in the house — which implies that specifically one of the men of the house] was not there; by implication, another man who was not of the men of the house — that is to say, distinct and set apart from the ways of the men of the house — was there, and this was the likeness of his father’s image. And it is somewhat puzzling: from where do we [know] that it appeared to him in the window? Perhaps [it is derived] from what is written, "in the house," which implies: not inside the house [itself, but at the window].

Tosafot on Sotah 36b:22:1.hebrew: איתשיל נמי אדידך ואע"ג דלא ניחא ליה - ותימה: הלא לא היה יכול לישאל על נדרו כי אם מדעתו של פרעה, כמו ההוא מעשה דצדקיהו ונבוכדנצר דמייתי התם? מיהו מהכא משמע דהוה בפניו, דאמר בפ' ר' אליעזר בנדרים (דף סה.): "המודר הנאה מחברו אין מתירין לו אלא בפניו", פי': בפניו, ואפילו בעל כרחו. ומיהו תימה לומר דהנודר על דעת חבירו מתירים לו שלא מדעת חבירו! ושמא אוקמיה במלתא דגיזום בעלמא, שגיזמו כך, מיהו לא היה יכול לישאל עליו אי לא ניחא ליה לפרעה:
Tosafot on Sotah 36b:22:1.english: "[And should I] also request [dissolution] for [the oath I took] for you?" And even though he was not amenable - And this is astonishing: Could [Joseph] not only request dissolution of his vow with Pharaoh's consent, like that incident of Zedekiah and Nebuchadnezzar that is brought there [in Nedarim]? However, from here it is implied that it was [a matter of being] in his presence, for it says in the chapter [entitled] R. Eliezer in Nedarim (65a): "One who is forbidden by a vow from benefiting from his fellow, they may only release him [from the vow] in his presence" — meaning, in his presence, and even against his will. However, it is astonishing to say that one who vows subject to his fellow's consent can be released without his fellow's consent! And perhaps [Joseph] merely put him off with a threat — that he threatened him in this way — although he could not [actually] have requested dissolution of it if Pharaoh were not willing.

Tosafot on Sotah 36b:4:1.hebrew: מאי והחציו חציו של מול הר גריזים מרובה מחציו של הר עיבל - לשון הירושלמי מיושב יותר, דגרסינן התם: מה תלמוד לומר "והחציו"? מלמד שמעוטין בהר גריזים ומרובין בהר עיבל. למה? שאין שבטו של לוי כולו שם, שאם היה כל שבט לוי שם היו שוין. ר' שמואל בר נחמני בשם ר' יונתן אמר: אילו היה כל שבטו של לוי שם, לא היו שוין. למה? שכבר נפלו משבטו של שמעון עשרים וארבעה אלף בשטים. א"ר יוסי בר בון: אילו היה שם כל שבטו של לוי, היו שוין. למה? שלא בא משבט ראובן וגד אלא מ' אלף חלוצי צבא. והשתא אתי שפיר "והחציו אל מול הר עיבל" — חציו המבורר שהוא הרוב, דהוי חציו בשבטים ורובא בגברי. ומיהו כשתדקדק במנין אחרון שנאמר בו "לאלה תחלק הארץ" (במדבר כ״ו:נ״ג) לאחר שמתו מרגלים, כדכתיב: "ובאלה לא היה איש וגו'", והיה בשנת הארבעים לאחר פטירת אהרן, דכתיב ביה: "ויעל אהרן הכהן וגו' וימת שם בשנת הארבעים לצאת בני ישראל מארץ מצרים בחדש החמישי" (שם לג), והכי מוכח בסדר עולם — תמצא במנין שבטים שעמדו על הר גריזים עודף על אותן שעמדו בהר עיבל תשע אלף חסר ק"ל. ואפילו אם עמדו לוים למטה שמנה אלף, עדיין היו מרובין של הר גריזים קרוב לאלף; שהרי אתה מוצא בפרטן של אותן שבטים שעמדו על הר עיבל שלש מאות ושבעת אלפים ותתק"ל, ובפרטן של הר גריזים ג' מאות וששה עשר אלף ות"ת. וי"ל: הא דאמרינן בירושלמי שאם היה שם כל שבט לוי היו שוין — לאו דוקא שוין, שהרי מרובין היו, אלא כלומר לא היו של הר גריזים פחותין. [והשתא שלא היו כל שבט לוי שם צריך לומר] שעמדו לוים למטה תשע אלף או יותר. אבל הא דאמר רבי שמואל בר נחמני בשם ר' יונתן: "אילו היה שם כל שבטו של לוי לא היו שוין, למה? שכבר נפלו משבטו של שמעון עשרים וארבעה אלף" — קשיא, שהרי המנין היה אחרי כן, כדכתיב: "ויהי אחרי המגפה וגו'" (שם כה). ומה שחלק עליו ר' יוסי בר בון לפי שלא בא משבט ראובן וגד אלא מ' אלף חלוצי צבא — א"כ לא נשארו משבט ראובן אלא ג' אלף ותש"ל, שהרי כל פקודי שבט [ראובן] לא היו כי אם מ"ג אלף ותש"ל; והיאך היו אותן ג' אלף ותש"ל של ראובן שנשארו מעבר לירדן ממלאין לכ"ד אלף שנפלו משמעון, שהיה בשנת הארבעים?! מיהו הא לא קשיא, דאיכא למימר דהכי קאמר: מחמת חסרון משבט שמעון שנפלו במגפה, אפילו היה שם שבטו של לוי לא היו שוין, דמתוך כך היו של הר גריזים מועטין — ולא שיחסרו מהן עשרים וארבעה אלף משמעון [אלא ג' אלפים או פחות]. ועלה קאי רבי יוסי בר בון: אפילו לדבריך, כשאתה מחסר כנגדו ג' אלף ותש"ל משבט ראובן שנשארו מעבר לירדן, והיו שוין — שמחמת חסרון משבט שמעון אין חסר יותר מג' אלף ותש"ל. אבל ההיא דר' שמואל בר נחמני תיקשי כדפרישית, שהמגפה היתה קודם למנין:
Tosafot on Sotah 36b:4:1.english: What is [meant by] "And the half of them"? The half that was facing Mount Gerizim was larger than the half of Mount Ebal - The wording of the Jerusalem Talmud is more settled [i.e., makes better sense], for we learn there: What does Scripture teach by saying "And the half of them"? It teaches that they were fewer on Mount Gerizim and more on Mount Ebal. Why? Because the entire tribe of Levi was not there, for if the entire tribe of Levi had been there, they would have been equal. Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonatan: Even if the entire tribe of Levi had been there, they would not have been equal. Why? Because twenty-four thousand from the tribe of Simeon had already fallen at Shittim. Rabbi Yosei bar Bun said: If the entire tribe of Levi had been there, they would have been equal. Why? Because only forty thousand armed troops came from the tribe of Reuben and Gad. And now [the verse] "and the half of them toward Mount Ebal" fits well — its selected half, which is the majority, so that it is half in [terms of the number of] tribes and the majority in [terms of] men. However, when you examine closely the last census, concerning which it is stated, "To these the land shall be divided" (Numbers 26:53), after the spies died — as it is written, "And among these there was not a man, etc." — and it was in the fortieth year after the passing of Aaron, as it is written concerning him, "And Aaron the priest went up, etc., and died there in the fortieth year after the children of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month" (ibid. 33), and so it is proven in Seder Olam — you will find in the count of the tribes that stood on Mount Gerizim an excess over those that stood on Mount Ebal of nine thousand minus one hundred and thirty [i.e., 8,870]. And even if eight thousand Levites stood below, those of Mount Gerizim would still be more [than those of Mount Ebal] by close to a thousand; for you find in the detailed count of those tribes that stood on Mount Ebal three hundred and seven thousand nine hundred and thirty [307,930], and in the detailed count of Mount Gerizim three hundred and sixteen thousand eight hundred [316,800]. And one can answer: That which we say in the Jerusalem Talmud, that if the entire tribe of Levi had been there they would have been equal, does not mean literally equal — for they were more — rather, it means to say that those of Mount Gerizim would not have been fewer. [And now that the entire tribe of Levi was not there, one must say] that nine thousand or more Levites stood below. However, that which Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonatan — "If the entire tribe of Levi had been there, they would not have been equal. Why? Because twenty-four thousand from the tribe of Simeon had already fallen" — is difficult, for the census was afterward, as it is written, "And it came to pass after the plague, etc." (ibid. 25). And [as for] that which Rabbi Yosei bar Bun disagreed with him because only forty thousand armed troops came from the tribe of Reuben and Gad — if so, only three thousand seven hundred and thirty [3,730] remained from the tribe of Reuben, for all the mustered men of the tribe of [Reuben] were only forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty [43,730]; and how could those three thousand seven hundred and thirty of Reuben who remained on the other side of the Jordan make up for the twenty-four thousand who fell from Simeon, which was in the fortieth year?! However, this is not difficult, for it is possible to say that this is what he is saying: Because of the deficit from the tribe of Simeon who fell in the plague, even if the tribe of Levi had been there, they would not have been equal, for thereby those of Mount Gerizim were fewer — and not that they were lacking twenty-four thousand from Simeon, [rather three thousand or fewer]. And to this Rabbi Yosei bar Bun refers: Even according to your words, when you subtract against it the three thousand seven hundred and thirty from the tribe of Reuben who remained on the other side of the Jordan, they are equal, for because of the deficit from the tribe of Simeon, there is no deficit of more than three thousand seven hundred and thirty. But that [statement] of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani remains difficult as I have explained, because the plague was before the census.
